notes: v10.4 BUILD REFRESH (2026-11-07, b4689 — the sixteenth cut — text lands, press again, record; the focus wake can never take your text; Windows win-v4.6, notarized): (1) The hold after a paste is gone: the moment your text has landed you can press the function key again and record — no "Still working on your last dictation…" notice, no wait. The only thing that still refuses a start is a decode in progress, and it ends the instant the text is posted. (2) The focus wake (the letter typed and deleted to wake a sleepy text field) now carries confirmation logic: it never fires within ten seconds of a paste; it never types into a field it cannot read (it moves the caret with an arrow key instead, which can delete nothing); and it reads the field's length before and after — if anything was lost it presses ⌘Z at once and shows the card. Your text can no longer vanish under a wake. (3) Windows win-v4.6 carries the same three rules and the same removal of the hold and its notice. Notarized by Ap
